intent: Provide a source-grounded experimental IconButton comparison for the Horizon RFC, preserving Sunrise defaults. Studio Figma supplies verified default shapes/colors/typography; AI Workspace/styleguide wrappers supply optional rounded shape, success tone and toolbar outline intent. This demonstration does not approve the design or release.

states.expected: Sunrise keeps existing secondary/normal appearance; Horizon scopes Figma-derived primary blue, neutral secondary and typography to the Button family.

states.trigger: Render default and rounded at each size
states.expected: Default retains the theme radius (Sunrise 8px, Horizon 12px); rounded is explicit pill/circle, never a theme-wide default.
Typed heights 32/36/44px. Compact 32 is a styleguide-derived proposal, not the distinct Figma 28px canvas control.
Existing variants remain available; success and outline translate application tones into the shared discriminated enum.
Visible token-driven focus and exactly one activation per key press with an accessible name.
Disabled semantics block focus and actions.

states.trigger: Activate Send message, which enters loading
states.expected: Busy state retains the action name and blocks repeated activation.

impact.summary: Add shape=default|rounded, size=small (32px), variant=success|outline to the shared Button API inherited by IconButton. Existing Sunrise default styles remain unchanged. Horizon default Button styles gain source-verified blue/neutral/typography; no universal rounded default and no icon-size change. Shared tests exercise both API consumers. Horizon button focus rings use stronger semantic colors for visibility; other components and Sunrise keep their existing focus tokens. Horizon text buttons hug content via auto minimum width; Sunrise retains its existing 100px minimum. Optional Button tokens fall back at each CSS consumer to the existing semantic tokens in Sunrise; no root aliases capture and break local overrides.
impact.consumerAction: Existing consumers require no change. Horizon consumers select its complete stylesheet in an isolated document. Replace wrapper data-sl-shape/tone usage with shape and variant; tone=success maps variant=success and tone=toolbarOutline maps variant=outline with size=small. This remains branch-only RFC code pending acceptance.

openQuestions: Approve 37px-to36px normalization and the source hover/pressed states not yet specified in Figma.
Approve accessibility-adjusted success colors, compact 32px and outline as reusable shared variants.
Review canonical visual baselines, screen reader behavior and full package coverage before release.
